_comment: "exclude" is a list of substrings matched against a desktop entry's id.
Anything matching is left alone entirely. Useful for an app whose own
theming is better than anything generated here.
The other keys turn individual handlers off; all default to true.

electron._comment: Add --force-dark-mode and WebContentsForceDark to Electron and Chromium launchers.

qt._comment: Write a qt5ct/qt6ct color scheme. Does nothing unless one of those tools is installed.

flatpak._comment: Per-application flatpak override --user for Qt runtime theme selection.

steam._comment: Write theme.vdf for each Steam profile found.

wallpaper._comment: Let the wallpaper palette tint the theme accent when the two hues agree. See harmonize_accent in lib/common.sh.
